stories.title: Smith moves to top of Buckeyes' all-time receiving yardage list
stories.summary: Ohio State star wide receiver Jeremiah Smith broke the Buckeyes' career receiving yardage record during Saturday's game against Kent State.

stories.title: Federal prosecutors identify 18 alleged rigged pitches for Clase trial
stories.summary: Prosecutors identified 18 pitches, including one from a 2024 playoff game, that will be the focus of their case against Guardians closer Emmanuel Clase that is set for trial in November, according to court documents.

stories.title: Source: Jets rookie WR Cooper Jr. placed on IR with sprained ankle
stories.summary: Jets rookie wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr., one of the team's three first-round picks, has been placed on injured reserve with a sprained ankle, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Steelers rule out WR Pittman Jr. vs. Patriots with foot injury
stories.summary: The Steelers will be without another starter for their Week 2 game against the Patriots after downgrading wide receiver Michael Pittman Jr. to out with a foot injury.

stories.title: Oregon wins in 84-0 rout despite missing 2 key players on offense
stories.summary: The Ducks were without some key players on offense for their historic 84-0 rout of Portland State as top wide receiver Jeremiah McClellan and starting tight end Jamari Johnson sat out because of injuries.
